content.title: WEIRD SIGNS YOU'RE ACTUALLY LOW ON {{NUTRIENTS}}
facts: **Iodine** – Unexplained weight gain, fatigue, puffy face, and feeling cold all the time.
**Vitamin K** – Bruising easily, bleeding gums, and cuts that take forever to stop.
**Vitamin A** – Night blindness, dry eyes, and frequent infections.
**Zinc** – Slow wound healing, loss of taste or smell, and brittle nails with white spots.
**Folate** – Pale skin, mouth sores, irritability, and constant exhaustion.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, vision problems, and numb or tingling limbs.
**Potassium** – Muscle cramps, irregular heartbeat, and that heavy, sluggish feeling in your legs.
**Calcium** – Numbness in fingers, muscle twitches, and weak, brittle nails.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these are easy to brush off as 'just being tired,' but they're worth paying attention to. Low **iodine** can slow your thyroid down, which is why it quietly messes with your metabolism and leaves you feeling cold and sluggish even when you're resting. **Zinc** deficiency affects your sense of taste and smell because zinc is needed for the enzymes that regenerate your taste buds and support immune cell repair, which is also why wounds take longer to close. And **folate** shortage shows up in your mouth and skin first because those cells turn over fast and need a steady supply of new DNA-building blocks to keep regenerating. Everyone's body is different, so these signs are a starting point, not a diagnosis.
